description: Returns the raw presentation JSON: slides[] with every page element (shapes, text runs, tables, images), layouts[], masters[], notesMaster, pageSize (EMU: 1 pt = 12700 EMU) and revisionId. WARNING: a full deck is often hundreds of kilobytes — prefer list_slides for an inventory, and pass fields (a Google fields mask, e.g. "slides(objectId,pageElements(objectId,shape(text)))") to trim this response when you need raw detail.

fields.description: Optional Google fields mask to trim the response, e.g. "slides(objectId),pageSize".

presentation_id.description: The presentation id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/presentation/d/<presentationId>/edit) or from create_presentation output.

name: get_presentation
title: Get a presentation
